# Sentinel test vectors

The JSON files here are copies, unchanged, of three vectors of [safe-research/sentinel-test-vectors](https://github.com/safe-research/sentinel-test-vectors) at commit `1e4b594228b55279717dcf3715c75883584a3d43`, which is licensed under the Apache License 2.0, as this repository is (see [`LICENSE`](../../../LICENSE)):

- `safenet_approve_stake_excess.json`, from `specs/safenet/`: an insecure vector under R-4.5;
- `0xAb876791757b47D202B7d6DeF038940cE7A64fe4_35.json`, from `specs/transfers/`: a secure vector;
- `usdt-100k-near-match.json`, from `specs/address-poisoning/`: an insecure vector under R-4.3 of an EOA transaction.
